description:
Regression suite for ticket/scope/none review policy copy and reviewer child-task composition. Product copy is owned by the prompt-appendix issue; this issue **must not rewrite** that module's voice, only fail the build if a required instruction disappears.

## Background

Default reviewPolicy is `ticket`. Scope and none are explicit. Parent dispositions fix|file|reject by judgment, not a keyword classifier. File is nonblocking unless the user waives a blocking finding in an ordinary turn.

If the appendix issue already contains the strings, this issue is still required: golden tests prevent a later “simplify the prompt” from deleting the tradeoff text.

## Files

- tests under `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/__tests__/`
- fixtures/goldens for each policy
- do not own prompt.ts unless a test-only export is missing (prefer exporting a testable builder)

## Assertions

- ticket: requires independent `reviewImplementation` before close.
- scope: allows close from evidence; requires `reviewScope` before epic complete; states dependents may start before aggregate review.
- none: does not require independent review children.
- reviewer task guidance: git show/commits/ticket id; do not start review of A while A is still implementing.
- no regex classifier; no structured-result gate language.

## Test plan

- Unit goldens per policy; fail on substring deletions listed above.
- Log policy name and which required phrases matched.

## Success criteria

- CI fails if required phrases are removed.
- No e2e here (ticket-policy and scope-policy e2e are siblings).
title: Golden tests for ticket/scope/none review prompt copy
